correctness.rationale: The no-switch disproof is algebraically exact given the admitted model: with fixed EE/II delays the linearized 2x2 rate matrix has off-diagonal delay factors exp(-iwd_EI), exp(-iwd_IE) whose product is exp(-iwT*) with T*=4ms fixed, so D(w;r)=(1-chiE*AEE)(1-chiI*AII)-chiE*AEI*chiI*AIE*exp(-iwT*) is exactly r-independent. Zero set, Hopf frequencies, growth rates and dominance ordering therefore cannot cross in r; eigenvector phase vE/vI proportional to exp(+iwd_IE(r)) rotates continuously. Numerics confirm structure: fixed point nuE=9.08/nuI=7.27 Hz fluctuation-driven (means below threshold), FP-vs-Siegert ~4%, chi(0)-vs-dnu/dmu ~5%, zero negative densities, determinant scans at r=0.2,0.5,1,2,5 identical to 9.2e-16 with common gamma minimum 30.10 Hz and monotone phases 1.304->0.800 rad; second point 33.85 Hz to 1.4e-15. Spiking sims show r-independent stationary rates (6.2/31.5 Hz) and seed-level PSD-peak noise (23 Hz shift at fixed r=0.5) with smooth lags, supporting no bistability. Proof and numerical/spiking evidence are correctly separated; boundary caveat on fixed EE/II delays is stated.

Negative resolution is therefore new, not a recomputation or corollary of a stated stronger fact.
